text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Pushing past her limits, Inari One claimed 
victory in the Tenno Sho (Autumn). Tamamo 
Cross praised her run.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap fired up her fighting spirit as 
well, exchanging a promise with Inari One 
to compete against each other again in 
next year's Tenno Sho (Autumn).
